thread:
hema: Quick follow-up from the RDI-4021 postmortem. We need owners for: regression prompt-sets, CI regression job, load-profile, and a recurring chaos drill. Can we agree names + dates?
noah: I can own the CI regression job and the triage rota. Plan: create a `ci-evals/regression-smoke` job that runs fast (<=30s) and a `ci-evals/regression-full` for nightly. I'll stub the job this week.
zara: I'll author the prompt-sets. Two groups: `regression/fallback_role_tokenization` and `regression/stopseq_truncation`. Each ~10 examples, focused on the failing prefixes and a few quantized-model variants. Target: PR with suites by Thu EOD.
maya: I'll take load-profile + monthly chaos automation. Proposal: baseline steady 200rps, 60s spike to 800rps, and an automated node-drain step during spike for a monthly scheduled drill. Will attach k6 script and runbook. Dry-run with SRE next Wed.
hema: Nice. Also need eval-harness changes: KV warmup, top-k distribution metric, and a canary gate that blocks promotion on regressions. Who takes that?
zara: I can add the harness hooks and metric wiring once prompt-sets land. Will add a top-k drift alert (>5%) and stopseq-failure rate alarm.
noah: Rotation for regression triage: eng-ml weekdays 09-18, eng-platform nights/weekends. I'll publish a tiny rota doc and add to postmortem follow-ups. Also will add a label `regression-needs-triage` that CI toggles on failure.
maya: k6 snippet for spike phase (will include in ticket): ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt:'role:user\\ncontent: test spike'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
hema: Deadlines recap: zara -> prompt-sets PR by 2026-04-02 EOD; noah -> CI jobs + rota doc by 2026-04-03; maya -> chaos automation dry-run by 2026-04-09; zara -> eval-harness wiring by 2026-04-06.
